from solution import remove


def test_issue_example():
    """Remove all digits from a list of strings."""
    result = remove(['4words', '3letters', '4digits'])
    expected = ['words', 'letters', 'digits']  # 3 in -> 3 out: 3==3
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_empty_list():
    """Remove all digits from a list of strings."""
    result = remove([])
    expected = []  # 0 in -> 0 out: 0==0
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_no_digits_unchanged():
    """Remove all digits from a list of strings."""
    result = remove(['hello', 'world'])
    expected = ['hello', 'world']  # 2 in -> 2 out: 1+1==2
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_only_digits_become_empty():
    """Remove all digits from a list of strings."""
    result = remove(['123', '007'])
    expected = ['', '']  # 2 in -> 2 out: 2==2; 3 chars - 3 digits = 0 chars: 3-3==0
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_digits_in_middle():
    """Remove all digits from a list of strings."""
    result = remove(['a1b2c3'])
    expected = ['abc']  # 1 in -> 1 out: 1==1; 6 chars - 3 digits = 3 chars: 6-3==3
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_digits_at_end():
    """Remove all digits from a list of strings."""
    result = remove(['abc123'])
    expected = ['abc']  # 1 in -> 1 out: 1==1; 6 chars - 3 digits = 3 chars: 6-3==3
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_all_ten_digits():
    """Remove all digits from a list of strings."""
    result = remove(['0123456789'])
    expected = ['']  # 1 in -> 1 out: 1==1; 10 chars - 10 digits = 0 chars: 10-10==0
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_empty_string_item():
    """Remove all digits from a list of strings."""
    result = remove(['', 'a1'])
    expected = ['', 'a']  # 2 in -> 2 out: 2==2; 2 chars - 1 digit = 1 char: 2-1==1
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_preserves_order():
    """Example shows remove returns a list in the same order."""
    result = remove(['b2', 'a1', 'c3'])
    expected = ['b', 'a', 'c']  # 3 in -> 3 out: 3==3; not sorted
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_preserves_count():
    """Remove all digits but keep every string entry."""
    result = remove(['1', 'a', '22', 'b3'])
    expected = ['', 'a', '', 'b']  # 4 in -> 4 out: 2+2==4
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_spaces_punctuation_untouched():
    """Remove all digits from a list of strings."""
    result = remove(['h3llo, w0rld!', '   '])
    expected = ['hllo, wrld!', '   ']  # 2 in -> 2 out: 2==2; only 2 digits removed: 13-2==11
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_leading_digit_word():
    """Remove all digits from a list of strings."""
    result = remove(['9lives', '0start', 'end9'])
    expected = ['lives', 'start', 'end']  # 3 in -> 3 out: 3==3; each loses 1 digit: 6-1==5
    assert result == expected
